basic_profile.bio: A history enthusiast based in Vancouver, I spend my free time exploring the nuances of World War II and engaging with aviation communities like hoggit. My occupation as an IT support specialist keeps me busy during the weekdays, but I enjoy unwinding by participating in online discussions about historical events and geopolitical topics. I'm single and typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM PST. Although I'm relatively new to the platform, I'm eager to expand my interactions and learn more from the diverse communities here.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep interest in history, particularly World War II, which I have cultivated through reading various books and online resources. My technical knowledge comes from my work experience in IT support, where I've developed skills in computer maintenance and troubleshooting.
